title: The Portfolio Build — 5 production platforms in 5 weeks
summary: 6–8 focused hours a day, and Claude Code writes most of the boilerplate while you make and defend the decisions. Your job each day is the ADR, the benchmark, the failure log, and being able to explain it. If a day runs over, the next day's row starts anyway; unfinished items go to that week's Day 7 buffer, never into the next week.

projects.sentence: a multi-tenant AI due-diligence analyst. A tenant's users give it a property address, company, or document set; planner and specialist agents retrieve, run SQL, call tools over MCP, calculate, and produce an evidence-backed memo, with approval gates, audit trail, evals, traces, and cost per tenant.

days.title: Repo, compose (pgvector, redis, api), api/main.py GET /healt
days.build: Repo, compose (pgvector, redis, api), api/main.py GET /health pinging both, Dockerfile.

days.title: Data + tenancy
days.build: Data + tenancy. db/migrations/001_init.sql: tenants, users(tenant_id, role), documents, chunks(tenant_id, embedding vector(384), tsv), runs, audit; scripts/migrate.py idempotent. ingest/download.py + ingest/load_tabular.py (TCAD + permits → parcels, permits). ingest/pdf.py (800-token chunks, unique (document_id, ord)). ingest/embed.py (bge-small-en-v1.5, batch 64) + 002_hnsw.sql. First BENCHMARKS.md table: chunks/sec.
days.run: python scripts/migrate.py && python ingest/download.py && python ingest/load_tabular.py && python ingest/pdf.py data/pdfs --tenant demo && python ingest/embed.py
days.done: parcels > 100k rows, chunks > 500, 0 null embeddings, reruns add 0.

days.title: Retrieval + agent runtime
days.build: Retrieval + agent runtime. retrieval/{vector,bm25,hybrid}.py (RRF k=60, all tenant-filtered), retrieval/rerank.py (bge-reranker-base). agent/tools.py: search_docs, sql_query (read-only role, 5s timeout, SELECT only), calc (safe ast), fetch_url (allowlist), send_email (requires_approval). agent/runtime.py: tool loop, max 12 steps, forced-schema Answer{answer, citations, confidence}. agents/*.yaml (planner, research, sql, finance, report) with allowed tools; prompts/*.yaml versioned. ADR-001 pgvector-vs-qdrant-vs-opensearch ("evidence: Day 12").
days.run: python -m agent.runtime --tenant demo "Median appraised value on Garcreek Cir and change vs last year?"
days.done: Trace shows sql_query → calc → cited answer; every citation id exists.

days.title: Durable workflows on Kafka
days.build: Durable workflows on Kafka. Redpanda in compose. events/schema.py (RunRequested, StepStarted/Finished, ApprovalRequested, RunFinished, all carry tenant_id, run_id). worker/main.py consumes runs.requested, emits to runs.events, commits offsets after RunFinished, idempotent per (run_id, step_no). POST /runs (idempotency key), GET /runs/{id} (state from events), GET /runs/{id}/stream SSE, POST /runs/{id}/approve. tenacity backoff, token budget 200k, step timeout 60s, circuit breaker, runs.dlq + GET /admin/dlq + retry. Planner/executor with parallel independent nodes (asyncio).
days.run: docker compose up; POST; rpk topic consume runs.events; then docker compose kill worker && docker compose up worker mid-run
days.done: Steps stream live; killed run resumes from last finished step with no duplicate side effects; approval pauses and resumes. FAILURES.md #1. ADR-002 event-sourced-runs, ADR-003 kafka-vs-sqs-vs-redis-streams.

days.title: Auth, RLS, RBAC, gateway, audit
days.build: Auth, RLS, RBAC, gateway, audit. Keycloak in compose (realm, tenants acme/globex as groups, roles viewer/analyst/admin); api/auth.py JWKS validation. Postgres row-level security keyed on current_setting('app.tenant') set per request. api/rbac.py + tests/test_rbac.py (3 roles × 6 endpoints) + tests/test_tenant_isolation.py. Go gateway gateway/: JWT check, per-tenant Redis token bucket, request id, SSE passthrough. Audit row per mutation and tool call. Per-tenant monthly token quota + GET /tenants/{id}/usage. docs/threat-model.md (10 threats → test or Day).
days.done: Isolation and RBAC tests green; acme cannot see globex via any endpoint or raw SQL as app role; 429 at the limit; ADR-004 go-gateway-vs-fastapi-only.

days.title: MCP, routing, LangGraph, UI
days.build: MCP, routing, LangGraph, UI. mcp_server/ exposing the tools (stdio + streamable HTTP); runtime becomes an MCP client via mcp.json, plus one third-party MCP server. llm/router.py (Haiku for extraction, frontier for planning/memo, local slot reserved for Week 3) + Redis semantic cache. agent/langgraph_runtime.py same graph; evals/compare_topology.py on 10 questions: single vs planner/executor vs LangGraph (latency, tokens, your 1–5 quality). web/ Next.js: Keycloak login, question, live steps, citation drawers, approve button, usage page → Vercel.
days.run: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector; python evals/compare_topology.py --all; npm run dev
days.done: Tools callable over MCP; comparison table in BENCHMARKS.md; ADR-005 mcp-vs-hardcoded-tools, ADR-006 custom-runtime-vs-langgraph; full flow works in a browser.

days.title: Evals, guardrails, OTel, deploy, ship
days.build: Evals, guardrails, OTel, deploy, ship. evals/questions.jsonl (60, tagged lookup/sql/multi-step/unanswerable, with expected_chunk_ids); evals/retrieval.py (Recall@5/10, MRR, NDCG, P95 for vector/bm25/hybrid/hybrid+rerank); evals/answer.py LLM-judge correctness + faithfulness, evals/human.csv on 20, agreement ≥ 0.8, abstention on unanswerables ≥ 90%. Guardrails: injection scan with 20 poisoned chunks, SSRF allowlist, PII redaction, per-agent tool permissions; SECURITY.md. OTel across gateway → api → kafka → worker, span attrs model/tokens/cost_usd/tenant_id; Tempo/Prom/Grafana/Phoenix in compose; alerts DLQ>5, P95>30s. CI gate on Recall@10 baseline. fly deploy (api, worker, gateway, Postgres, Upstash Redis + Kafka). README/ARCHITECTURE/COST. Applications 1–3 (HackerOne, PressW, Linkt).
days.run: python evals/retrieval.py --modes all && python evals/answer.py && pytest tests/security && fly deploy
days.done: Four-row retrieval table and judge table in BENCHMARKS.md; one run = one trace; public URL works from your phone; 3 applications logged in applications.md; git tag v1.0.

projects.title: agent-platform
projects.proves: Multi-tenant agentic AI platform: RBAC, MCP, Kafka workers, approval gates, evals, OTel, deployed

projects.sentence: an enterprise ingestion + retrieval backbone that takes streams and files of any type through bronze/silver/gold on Delta Lake and serves hybrid search over millions of chunks, and becomes Week 1's search_docs.
stack: GitHub Actions. Databricks Free edition for one notebook-based Spark UI comparison on Day 11.

days.title: Repo. Compose: redpanda, minio, spark-master, spark-worker,
days.build: Repo. Compose: redpanda, minio, spark-master, spark-worker, dagster, opensearch, db (pgvector). producers/{parcels,permits,edgar,pdf}.py publish rows/files to topics raw.parcels, raw.permits, raw.docs (docs as S3 keys). jobs/bronze.py: Spark structured streaming → Delta bronze/<topic> on MinIO with checkpointing.
days.run: docker compose up && python producers/parcels.py && spark-submit jobs/bronze.py
days.done: bronze/parcels Delta table has > 100k rows; restart the job, it resumes from the checkpoint with 0 duplicates.

days.title: jobs/silver.py: typed schemas, dedup by natural key + event_
days.build: jobs/silver.py: typed schemas, dedup by natural key + event_ts, late events (watermark 1h) into silver/*; schema evolution with mergeSchema; quarantine table for bad rows with reason. jobs/gold.py: gold/parcels_current, gold/permits_by_parcel, gold/doc_chunks (parsing + 800-token chunking as a Spark UDF). Dagster assets + schedule wiring the three. Lineage visible in Dagster.
days.done: Gold tables populated; add a column to a producer and rerun: silver evolves, nothing breaks; quarantine has rows with reasons. ADR-007 delta-vs-parquet-vs-iceberg.

days.title: jobs/embed.py: Spark batch embeddings (bge-small, mapPartiti
days.build: jobs/embed.py: Spark batch embeddings (bge-small, mapPartitions, batch 256) → gold/doc_chunks_emb. Generate synthetic docs to reach 5M chunks. Writers: index/to_opensearch.py (BM25 + kNN), index/to_pgvector.py (HNSW). Record indexing throughput and index build time for both.
days.run: spark-submit jobs/embed.py && python index/to_opensearch.py && python index/to_pgvector.py
days.done: 5M chunks in both stores; throughput table in BENCHMARKS.md.

days.title: search/ FastAPI: /search with modes vector / bm25 / hybrid / hybrid…
days.build: search/ FastAPI: /search with modes vector / bm25 / hybrid / hybrid+rerank / query-decomposition / HyDE, metadata filters, tenant filter. evals/ 100 questions with expected chunks. Run all modes on both stores at 5M: Recall@10, MRR, NDCG, P50/P95, $/query estimate. Open the same gold table in Databricks Free, run one aggregation, compare the Spark UI plan with local.
days.done: Full matrix in BENCHMARKS.md. ADR-001 in Week 1 updated with this evidence and a switch threshold. ADR-008 opensearch-vs-pgvector-at-5M.

days.title: Break it
days.build: Break it. Drills, one hour each, postmortem each in docs/postmortems/: duplicate messages (producer re-sends 10%), kill a Spark worker mid-batch, backpressure (producer 10× faster than consumer), skewed key (one parcel with 1M events), corrupt Parquet file, schema change without mergeSchema. Measure at-least-once vs exactly-once (Delta idempotent writes with txnAppId/txnVersion).
days.done: Six postmortems; at least three code changes; exactly-once proven with a count.

days.title: Repoint Week 1's search_docs MCP tool at this service; Week 1 evals…
days.build: Repoint Week 1's search_docs MCP tool at this service; Week 1 evals rerun. Data-quality checks as Dagster asset checks (row counts, null rates, freshness) with alerts. OTel on the search API + Spark metrics into Prometheus; Grafana dashboard: lag, batch duration, rows/sec, P95 search. CI: unit tests for transforms with chispa, small end-to-end on a 1k-row fixture.
days.done: Week 1 Recall@10 same or better; dashboard has data; CI green.

days.title: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING (what changes at 100M chunks
days.build: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING (what changes at 100M chunks, 1TB/day). Demo video 90s. Case study page. git tag v1.0. Applications 4–6 (Databricks FDE, PRIMUS, Homeward). Buffer for red items.
days.done: Everything linked from README; 3 applications logged.

projects.title: data-platform
projects.proves: Kafka → Spark/Delta → bronze/silver/gold → millions of chunks, hybrid + rerank, benchmarked

projects.sentence: the shared Kubernetes platform (Terraform, EKS, ArgoCD) plus a full ML lifecycle: features from Week 2 gold → training → registry → validation gates → GPU inference on your own NVIDIA machines and AWS → drift → retrain, with model routing back into Week 1.
stack: EKS (spot) + your local GPU machines joined as workers (k3s agent or kubeadm join over Tailscale)

days.title: Shared platform
days.build: Shared platform. platform/terraform/: VPC, EKS (one spot t3.medium group), RDS pg16 (pgvector), ElastiCache, S3, ECR, Secrets Manager, Cognito, remote state (S3 + DynamoDB). terraform apply. Helm-install OTel collector, Prometheus, Grafana, KEDA, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts. Join one local GPU machine as a node over Tailscale (label gpu=true), install NVIDIA device plugin. COST.md per-resource estimate.
days.done: Cloud node + your GPU node both Ready; nvidia-smi runs in a pod on the GPU node. ADR-009 eks-vs-ecs, ADR-010 hybrid-local-gpu-nodes.

days.title: Helm charts for Week 1 (gateway
days.build: Helm charts for Week 1 (gateway, api, worker with KEDA on Kafka lag) and Week 2 (search API). ArgoCD app-of-apps on a deploy/ directory; CI builds images to ECR and bumps values; Argo Rollouts canary 10→100% on the api. Cognito replaces Keycloak (OIDC config only). Migrate Fly → EKS; retire Fly. Runbooks: deploy, rollback, rotate secret, scale, drain DLQ, DB restore.
days.done: Rollout happens with no manual kubectl; rollback via Argo in < 2 min; Week 1 URL now on the ALB.

days.title: ML lifecycle
days.build: ML lifecycle. ml-platform repo. features/build.py from Week 2 gold (parcels_current + permits) → feature table in Delta. train/{linear,lightgbm,xgboost,mlp}.py for appraised-value and rent prediction, MLflow tracking (params, metrics, artifacts), train/validate.py gate (RMSE/MAE vs baseline, leakage check, feature-drift check) → registry promotion staging→production. Ray Train job on the cluster for the MLP.
days.done: MLflow shows 4 runs; one model in production; a deliberately leaked feature fails the gate. ADR-011 boosting-vs-nn-tabular.

days.title: Serving
days.build: Serving. KServe InferenceService for the LightGBM model (CPU) and a YOLOv11 + CLIP image pipeline on the GPU node via Triton (models/ repo with config.pbtxt, dynamic batching). Export YOLO to ONNX and TensorRT. serve/bench.py: PyTorch eager vs torch.compile vs ONNX Runtime vs TensorRT at FP32/FP16/INT8, batch 1/8/32: throughput, P50/P95/P99, GPU util, VRAM.
days.done: Benchmark matrix in BENCHMARKS.md; a one-sentence recommendation with a threshold. ADR-012 triton-vs-kserve-raw-vs-fastapi.

days.title: Monitoring + retrain
days.build: Monitoring + retrain. Evidently jobs comparing live inference inputs to training features (data drift) and rolling error vs delayed truth (concept drift) → Prometheus metrics → alert. retrain/pipeline.py triggered by the alert: retrain, validate gate, canary two versions with Argo Rollouts, auto-rollback if canary RMSE worse. drills/inject_drift.py.
days.done: Drift alert fires within 10 min; retrain runs; canary promoted or rolled back with logged numbers. Postmortem.

days.title: Local LLM serving
days.build: Local LLM serving. vLLM on the GPU node serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (or the largest that fits) with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; Prometheus metrics (tokens/s, TTFT, queue). Week 1 router local slot → this endpoint for extraction/classification; rerun Week 1 evals with --router local: cost and quality delta. serve/llm_bench.py: FP16 vs AWQ INT4, concurrency 1/8/32.
days.done: Cost-per-run row before/after in Week 1 BENCHMARKS.md; LLM benchmark table here. ADR-013 vllm-vs-tgi-vs-ollama.

days.title: Load test the serving path (k6
days.build: Load test the serving path (k6, 100 rps); GPU node down drill; postmortems. README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING, demo video, case study. git tag v1.0. Applications 7–9 (AMP, Apptronik, Evlo). terraform destroy if no demo tomorrow (re-apply Day 22 morning; keep it to one command).
days.done: Everything linked; 3 applications.

projects.title: ml-platform
projects.proves: Terraform/EKS/ArgoCD shared platform; train → registry → GPU inference (Triton/ONNX/TensorRT/vLLM) → drift → retrain

projects.sentence: a GitHub App that turns an issue into a tested pull request using indexed code, planning, sandboxed execution, review, and budgets, measured on SWE-bench, and registered as an agent inside Week 1.
stack: Docker-in-Kubernetes sandboxes (one Job per task, gVisor if available)
Anthropic SDK + Week 3 local model via router
MCP (exposes itself as a tool to Week 1).

days.title: Repo. GitHub App (webhook/ FastAPI receiving issues.labeled
days.build: Repo. GitHub App (webhook/ FastAPI receiving issues.labeled with label agent). index/: clone, tree-sitter symbol extraction (Python + TS), embeddings per symbol/file, incremental by commit SHA. search/: symbol lookup + semantic + import-graph neighbors.
days.run: Label an issue on a test repo
days.done: Webhook event logged; index for a 50k-line repo builds in < 5 min; search "where is auth validated" returns the right file.

days.title: planner/: issue → plan (files_to_touch
days.build: planner/: issue → plan (files_to_touch, tests_to_run, acceptance). sandbox/: Kubernetes Job per task from a repo image, mounts the checkout, network off, 30-min limit. coder/: edit loop (apply diff → run tests → read failures → revise), max 8 iterations, token + $ budget. Lint + type check + bandit before PR.
days.done: A real small issue (e.g. rename + test) produces a green PR. FAILURES.md entries for every loop that did not converge.

days.title: reviewer/ agent: reads the diff
days.build: reviewer/ agent: reads the diff, checks acceptance criteria, flags risk, posts a review comment; human approval gate before PR opens (reuse Week 1's approval event). Cost, tokens, iterations recorded per task in Postgres; Grafana panel.
days.done: 5 PRs with review comments and a cost per task on the dashboard.

days.title: Benchmark
days.build: Benchmark. SWE-bench Lite harness (benchmarks/swebench.py) on 100 tasks in parallel Jobs on the cluster. Report: resolved %, tests passed, iterations, tokens, $/task, wall time.
days.done: Results table in BENCHMARKS.md. Publish the raw JSONL.

days.title: Ablations
days.build: Ablations on the same 100: single agent vs planner/executor; full-file context vs retrieval; frontier vs local model for the coder; with vs without reviewer.
days.done: Ablation table; ADR-014 agent-topology-for-code, ADR-015 retrieval-vs-full-context with numbers.

days.title: Register as an MCP server so Week 1's planner can delegate implemen…
days.build: Register as an MCP server so Week 1's planner can delegate implement_change tasks; Week 1 approval gate applies. Failure drills: sandbox OOM, flaky tests, repo with no tests. Postmortems.
days.run: Ask Week 1 "add a /version endpoint to agent-platform"
days.done: Week 1 opens a PR on itself through Week 4.

days.title: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SECURITY (sandbox threat model)
days.build: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SECURITY (sandbox threat model), demo video, case study. git tag v1.0. Applications 10–12 (TTEC code agents, Fluidstack, LangChain).
days.done: 3 applications.

projects.title: autonomous-swe
projects.proves: GitHub issue → sandboxed, tested PR, SWE-bench numbers

projects.sentence: a GPT built from scratch, trained on your GPUs with the real training stack, post-trained, served two ways and benchmarked, then plugged into Week 3 and Week 1 so all five systems are one platform.
stack: DDP across your local GPUs (FSDP if 2+ cards)

days.title: Repo. model/: BPE tokenizer trained on the corpus; Embedding
days.build: Repo. model/: BPE tokenizer trained on the corpus; Embedding, RoPE, RMSNorm, GQA attention with causal mask + KV cache, SwiGLU MLP, residual blocks, tied LM head, sampling (temperature/top-p). tests/: each module vs a reference (HF Llama config at tiny size, max abs diff < 1e-4).
days.done: All green. docs/why.md started: why RoPE, why RMSNorm, why GQA (one paragraph each, with the VRAM arithmetic).

days.title: train/: data loader over a public corpus (FineWeb-Edu sample
days.build: train/: data loader over a public corpus (FineWeb-Edu sample, ~2B tokens), AdamW, cosine LR with warmup, grad accumulation, grad clipping, bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, DDP, checkpoint/resume, W&B. Launch a 125M model.
days.done: Loss curve in W&B; kill and resume once; BENCHMARKS.md: tokens/sec/GPU, MFU estimate, VRAM breakdown (weights/grads/optimizer/activations).

days.title: Training continues
days.build: Training continues. Meanwhile serve/own_server.py: your inference server with KV cache, continuous batching, streaming. serve/bench.py: tokens/s, TTFT, P50/P95, VRAM at concurrency 1/8/32, FP16 vs INT8 (torch.ao/bitsandbytes).
days.done: Table. Explain compute-bound vs memory-bandwidth-bound with your own numbers.

days.title: Stop pretraining at the token budget
days.build: Stop pretraining at the token budget. lm-eval-harness on a few tasks (sanity, not glory). post/sft.py on an instruction set (Alpaca-style, 20k) with LoRA; post/dpo.py on a preference set (UltraFeedback sample). Eval before/after on 50 held-out prompts with the Week 1 judge.
days.run: python post/sft.py && python post/dpo.py && python evals/judge.py
days.done: Before/after table; adapters saved as MLflow artifacts in Week 3's registry.

days.title: Serve the SFT/DPO model with vLLM (convert to HF format) and with T…
days.build: Serve the SFT/DPO model with vLLM (convert to HF format) and with Triton; rerun serve/bench.py --server vllm and compare to your server. Speculative decoding attempt with the 125M as draft for the 7B in Week 3 (record whether it helps).
days.done: Three-way table (own / vLLM / Triton). ADR-016 own-server-vs-vllm with numbers. docs/why.md complete (KV cache at long context, FlashAttention, quantization effects, LR/batch stability observations).

days.title: Integration
days.build: Integration. Week 3 router registers nevyn-lm as a model; Week 1 router uses it for classification; Week 1 evals rerun with it. One end-to-end demo: login → question → Week 2 retrieval → Week 4 opens a PR → Week 3 serves local models → Week 5 model in the mix, one trace across all of it. Top-level nevyn-ai-platform/README.md with the ecosystem diagram linking the five repos.
days.done: One trace spans all five systems.

days.title: Website: five case studies + platform overview
days.build: Website: five case studies + platform overview. Résumé: every vague bullet replaced with a measured number. Pin the five repos. Mock interview on the six levels for each repo (10 min each, recorded); gaps into FAILURES.md. Applications 13–15 (Visa, Expedia, Dayjob) and update every open application. terraform destroy.
days.done: 15+ applications sent over 5 weeks; all five repos tagged v1.0.

projects.title: nevyn-lm
projects.proves: Transformer from scratch → train on your GPUs → SFT/LoRA → serve, then wire all five together

days.title: agent-platform: Evals, guardrails, OTel, deploy, ship
days.build: Evals, guardrails, OTel, deploy, ship. evals/questions.jsonl (60, tagged lookup/sql/multi-step/unanswerable, with expected_chunk_ids); evals/retrieval.py (Recall@5/10, MRR, NDCG, P95 for vector/bm25/hybrid/hybrid+rerank); evals/answer.py LLM-judge correctness + faithfulness, evals/human.csv on 20, agreement ≥ 0.8, abstention on unanswerables ≥ 90%. Guardrails: injection scan with 20 poisoned chunks, SSRF allowlist, PII redaction, per-agent tool permissions; SECURITY.md. OTel across gateway → api → kafka → worker, span attrs model/tokens/cost_usd/tenant_id; Tempo/Prom/Grafana/Phoenix in compose; alerts DLQ>5, P95>30s. CI gate on Recall@10 baseline. fly deploy (api, worker, gateway, Postgres, Upstash Redis + Kafka). README/ARCHITECTURE/COST. Applications 1–3 (HackerOne, PressW, Linkt).
days.drill: python evals/retrieval.py --modes all && python evals/answer.py && pytest tests/security && fly deploy
days.done: Four-row retrieval table and judge table in BENCHMARKS.md; one run = one trace; public URL works from your phone; 3 applications logged in applications.md; git tag v1.0.

days.title: data-platform: Repo. Compose: redpanda, minio, spark-master, spark-worker,
days.build: Repo. Compose: redpanda, minio, spark-master, spark-worker, dagster, opensearch, db (pgvector). producers/{parcels,permits,edgar,pdf}.py publish rows/files to topics raw.parcels, raw.permits, raw.docs (docs as S3 keys). jobs/bronze.py: Spark structured streaming → Delta bronze/<topic> on MinIO with checkpointing.
days.drill: docker compose up && python producers/parcels.py && spark-submit jobs/bronze.py
days.done: bronze/parcels Delta table has > 100k rows; restart the job, it resumes from the checkpoint with 0 duplicates.

days.title: data-platform: jobs/silver.py: typed schemas, dedup by natural key + event_
days.build: jobs/silver.py: typed schemas, dedup by natural key + event_ts, late events (watermark 1h) into silver/*; schema evolution with mergeSchema; quarantine table for bad rows with reason. jobs/gold.py: gold/parcels_current, gold/permits_by_parcel, gold/doc_chunks (parsing + 800-token chunking as a Spark UDF). Dagster assets + schedule wiring the three. Lineage visible in Dagster.
days.done: Gold tables populated; add a column to a producer and rerun: silver evolves, nothing breaks; quarantine has rows with reasons. ADR-007 delta-vs-parquet-vs-iceberg.

days.title: data-platform: jobs/embed.py: Spark batch embeddings (bge-small, mapPartiti
days.build: jobs/embed.py: Spark batch embeddings (bge-small, mapPartitions, batch 256) → gold/doc_chunks_emb. Generate synthetic docs to reach 5M chunks. Writers: index/to_opensearch.py (BM25 + kNN), index/to_pgvector.py (HNSW). Record indexing throughput and index build time for both.
days.drill: spark-submit jobs/embed.py && python index/to_opensearch.py && python index/to_pgvector.py
days.done: 5M chunks in both stores; throughput table in BENCHMARKS.md.

days.title: data-platform: search/ FastAPI: /search with modes vector / bm25 / hybrid / hybrid…
days.build: search/ FastAPI: /search with modes vector / bm25 / hybrid / hybrid+rerank / query-decomposition / HyDE, metadata filters, tenant filter. evals/ 100 questions with expected chunks. Run all modes on both stores at 5M: Recall@10, MRR, NDCG, P50/P95, $/query estimate. Open the same gold table in Databricks Free, run one aggregation, compare the Spark UI plan with local.
days.done: Full matrix in BENCHMARKS.md. ADR-001 in Week 1 updated with this evidence and a switch threshold. ADR-008 opensearch-vs-pgvector-at-5M.

days.title: data-platform: Break it
days.build: Break it. Drills, one hour each, postmortem each in docs/postmortems/: duplicate messages (producer re-sends 10%), kill a Spark worker mid-batch, backpressure (producer 10× faster than consumer), skewed key (one parcel with 1M events), corrupt Parquet file, schema change without mergeSchema. Measure at-least-once vs exactly-once (Delta idempotent writes with txnAppId/txnVersion).
days.done: Six postmortems; at least three code changes; exactly-once proven with a count.

days.title: data-platform: Repoint Week 1's search_docs MCP tool at this service; Week 1 evals…
days.build: Repoint Week 1's search_docs MCP tool at this service; Week 1 evals rerun. Data-quality checks as Dagster asset checks (row counts, null rates, freshness) with alerts. OTel on the search API + Spark metrics into Prometheus; Grafana dashboard: lag, batch duration, rows/sec, P95 search. CI: unit tests for transforms with chispa, small end-to-end on a 1k-row fixture.
days.done: Week 1 Recall@10 same or better; dashboard has data; CI green.

days.title: data-platform: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING (what changes at 100M chunks
days.build: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING (what changes at 100M chunks, 1TB/day). Demo video 90s. Case study page. git tag v1.0. Applications 4–6 (Databricks FDE, PRIMUS, Homeward). Buffer for red items.
days.done: Everything linked from README; 3 applications logged.

days.title: ml-platform: Shared platform
days.build: Shared platform. platform/terraform/: VPC, EKS (one spot t3.medium group), RDS pg16 (pgvector), ElastiCache, S3, ECR, Secrets Manager, Cognito, remote state (S3 + DynamoDB). terraform apply. Helm-install OTel collector, Prometheus, Grafana, KEDA, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts. Join one local GPU machine as a node over Tailscale (label gpu=true), install NVIDIA device plugin. COST.md per-resource estimate.
days.done: Cloud node + your GPU node both Ready; nvidia-smi runs in a pod on the GPU node. ADR-009 eks-vs-ecs, ADR-010 hybrid-local-gpu-nodes.

days.title: ml-platform: Helm charts for Week 1 (gateway
days.build: Helm charts for Week 1 (gateway, api, worker with KEDA on Kafka lag) and Week 2 (search API). ArgoCD app-of-apps on a deploy/ directory; CI builds images to ECR and bumps values; Argo Rollouts canary 10→100% on the api. Cognito replaces Keycloak (OIDC config only). Migrate Fly → EKS; retire Fly. Runbooks: deploy, rollback, rotate secret, scale, drain DLQ, DB restore.
days.done: Rollout happens with no manual kubectl; rollback via Argo in < 2 min; Week 1 URL now on the ALB.

days.title: ml-platform: ML lifecycle
days.build: ML lifecycle. ml-platform repo. features/build.py from Week 2 gold (parcels_current + permits) → feature table in Delta. train/{linear,lightgbm,xgboost,mlp}.py for appraised-value and rent prediction, MLflow tracking (params, metrics, artifacts), train/validate.py gate (RMSE/MAE vs baseline, leakage check, feature-drift check) → registry promotion staging→production. Ray Train job on the cluster for the MLP.
days.done: MLflow shows 4 runs; one model in production; a deliberately leaked feature fails the gate. ADR-011 boosting-vs-nn-tabular.

days.title: ml-platform: Serving
days.build: Serving. KServe InferenceService for the LightGBM model (CPU) and a YOLOv11 + CLIP image pipeline on the GPU node via Triton (models/ repo with config.pbtxt, dynamic batching). Export YOLO to ONNX and TensorRT. serve/bench.py: PyTorch eager vs torch.compile vs ONNX Runtime vs TensorRT at FP32/FP16/INT8, batch 1/8/32: throughput, P50/P95/P99, GPU util, VRAM.
days.done: Benchmark matrix in BENCHMARKS.md; a one-sentence recommendation with a threshold. ADR-012 triton-vs-kserve-raw-vs-fastapi.

days.title: ml-platform: Monitoring + retrain
days.build: Monitoring + retrain. Evidently jobs comparing live inference inputs to training features (data drift) and rolling error vs delayed truth (concept drift) → Prometheus metrics → alert. retrain/pipeline.py triggered by the alert: retrain, validate gate, canary two versions with Argo Rollouts, auto-rollback if canary RMSE worse. drills/inject_drift.py.
days.done: Drift alert fires within 10 min; retrain runs; canary promoted or rolled back with logged numbers. Postmortem.

days.title: ml-platform: Local LLM serving
days.build: Local LLM serving. vLLM on the GPU node serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (or the largest that fits) with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; Prometheus metrics (tokens/s, TTFT, queue). Week 1 router local slot → this endpoint for extraction/classification; rerun Week 1 evals with --router local: cost and quality delta. serve/llm_bench.py: FP16 vs AWQ INT4, concurrency 1/8/32.
days.done: Cost-per-run row before/after in Week 1 BENCHMARKS.md; LLM benchmark table here. ADR-013 vllm-vs-tgi-vs-ollama.

days.title: ml-platform: Load test the serving path (k6
days.build: Load test the serving path (k6, 100 rps); GPU node down drill; postmortems. README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SCALING, demo video, case study. git tag v1.0. Applications 7–9 (AMP, Apptronik, Evlo). terraform destroy if no demo tomorrow (re-apply Day 22 morning; keep it to one command).
days.done: Everything linked; 3 applications.

days.title: autonomous-swe: Repo. GitHub App (webhook/ FastAPI receiving issues.labeled
days.build: Repo. GitHub App (webhook/ FastAPI receiving issues.labeled with label agent). index/: clone, tree-sitter symbol extraction (Python + TS), embeddings per symbol/file, incremental by commit SHA. search/: symbol lookup + semantic + import-graph neighbors.
days.drill: Label an issue on a test repo
days.done: Webhook event logged; index for a 50k-line repo builds in < 5 min; search "where is auth validated" returns the right file.

days.title: autonomous-swe: planner/: issue → plan (files_to_touch
days.build: planner/: issue → plan (files_to_touch, tests_to_run, acceptance). sandbox/: Kubernetes Job per task from a repo image, mounts the checkout, network off, 30-min limit. coder/: edit loop (apply diff → run tests → read failures → revise), max 8 iterations, token + $ budget. Lint + type check + bandit before PR.
days.done: A real small issue (e.g. rename + test) produces a green PR. FAILURES.md entries for every loop that did not converge.

days.title: autonomous-swe: reviewer/ agent: reads the diff
days.build: reviewer/ agent: reads the diff, checks acceptance criteria, flags risk, posts a review comment; human approval gate before PR opens (reuse Week 1's approval event). Cost, tokens, iterations recorded per task in Postgres; Grafana panel.
days.done: 5 PRs with review comments and a cost per task on the dashboard.

days.title: autonomous-swe: Benchmark
days.build: Benchmark. SWE-bench Lite harness (benchmarks/swebench.py) on 100 tasks in parallel Jobs on the cluster. Report: resolved %, tests passed, iterations, tokens, $/task, wall time.
days.done: Results table in BENCHMARKS.md. Publish the raw JSONL.

days.title: autonomous-swe: Ablations
days.build: Ablations on the same 100: single agent vs planner/executor; full-file context vs retrieval; frontier vs local model for the coder; with vs without reviewer.
days.done: Ablation table; ADR-014 agent-topology-for-code, ADR-015 retrieval-vs-full-context with numbers.

days.title: autonomous-swe: Register as an MCP server so Week 1's planner can delegate implemen…
days.build: Register as an MCP server so Week 1's planner can delegate implement_change tasks; Week 1 approval gate applies. Failure drills: sandbox OOM, flaky tests, repo with no tests. Postmortems.
days.drill: Ask Week 1 "add a /version endpoint to agent-platform"
days.done: Week 1 opens a PR on itself through Week 4.

days.title: autonomous-swe: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SECURITY (sandbox threat model)
days.build: README/ARCHITECTURE/COST/SECURITY (sandbox threat model), demo video, case study. git tag v1.0. Applications 10–12 (TTEC code agents, Fluidstack, LangChain).
days.done: 3 applications.

days.title: nevyn-lm: Repo. model/: BPE tokenizer trained on the corpus; Embedding
days.build: Repo. model/: BPE tokenizer trained on the corpus; Embedding, RoPE, RMSNorm, GQA attention with causal mask + KV cache, SwiGLU MLP, residual blocks, tied LM head, sampling (temperature/top-p). tests/: each module vs a reference (HF Llama config at tiny size, max abs diff < 1e-4).
days.done: All green. docs/why.md started: why RoPE, why RMSNorm, why GQA (one paragraph each, with the VRAM arithmetic).

days.title: nevyn-lm: train/: data loader over a public corpus (FineWeb-Edu sample
days.build: train/: data loader over a public corpus (FineWeb-Edu sample, ~2B tokens), AdamW, cosine LR with warmup, grad accumulation, grad clipping, bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, DDP, checkpoint/resume, W&B. Launch a 125M model.
days.done: Loss curve in W&B; kill and resume once; BENCHMARKS.md: tokens/sec/GPU, MFU estimate, VRAM breakdown (weights/grads/optimizer/activations).

days.title: nevyn-lm: Training continues
days.build: Training continues. Meanwhile serve/own_server.py: your inference server with KV cache, continuous batching, streaming. serve/bench.py: tokens/s, TTFT, P50/P95, VRAM at concurrency 1/8/32, FP16 vs INT8 (torch.ao/bitsandbytes).
days.done: Table. Explain compute-bound vs memory-bandwidth-bound with your own numbers.

days.title: nevyn-lm: Stop pretraining at the token budget
days.build: Stop pretraining at the token budget. lm-eval-harness on a few tasks (sanity, not glory). post/sft.py on an instruction set (Alpaca-style, 20k) with LoRA; post/dpo.py on a preference set (UltraFeedback sample). Eval before/after on 50 held-out prompts with the Week 1 judge.
days.drill: python post/sft.py && python post/dpo.py && python evals/judge.py
days.done: Before/after table; adapters saved as MLflow artifacts in Week 3's registry.

days.title: nevyn-lm: Serve the SFT/DPO model with vLLM (convert to HF format) and with T…
days.build: Serve the SFT/DPO model with vLLM (convert to HF format) and with Triton; rerun serve/bench.py --server vllm and compare to your server. Speculative decoding attempt with the 125M as draft for the 7B in Week 3 (record whether it helps).
days.done: Three-way table (own / vLLM / Triton). ADR-016 own-server-vs-vllm with numbers. docs/why.md complete (KV cache at long context, FlashAttention, quantization effects, LR/batch stability observations).

days.title: nevyn-lm: Integration
days.build: Integration. Week 3 router registers nevyn-lm as a model; Week 1 router uses it for classification; Week 1 evals rerun with it. One end-to-end demo: login → question → Week 2 retrieval → Week 4 opens a PR → Week 3 serves local models → Week 5 model in the mix, one trace across all of it. Top-level nevyn-ai-platform/README.md with the ecosystem diagram linking the five repos.
days.done: One trace spans all five systems.

days.title: nevyn-lm: Website: five case studies + platform overview
days.build: Website: five case studies + platform overview. Résumé: every vague bullet replaced with a measured number. Pin the five repos. Mock interview on the six levels for each repo (10 min each, recorded); gaps into FAILURES.md. Applications 13–15 (Visa, Expedia, Dayjob) and update every open application. terraform destroy.
days.done: 15+ applications sent over 5 weeks; all five repos tagged v1.0.
